thread.title: Intel slide on possible Apple Mac chip change a buying opportunity, says Stifel

author: fifcadmin
title: Intel slide on possible Apple Mac chip change a buying opportunity, says Stifel
text:
April 2, 2018 - 2:43pm The Fly 
Stifel analyst Kevin Cassidy said he believes Intel (INTC) shares are overreacting to the report that Apple (AAPL) may use an internally developed CPU for its Mac computers as early as 2020 and he recommends buying Intel shares on the weakness. Apple had only 7.3% share in terms of units of the traditional PC market in Q4 of 2017 and market share losses may be behind the decision as an effort to differentiate its platforms, said Cassidy, citing data from IDC. The analyst, who estimates that Apple accounted for about 4% of Intel's total 2017 revenue and less than 1% of its total profits, maintains a Buy rating and $53 price target on Intel shares. Go!
